ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity pixels (white/off-white) occupying approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on the trailing margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black banding along the distal trailing edge; diffuse brownish-tan mottling clusters in the medial regions of both lobes; a cluster of three distinct black circular spots in a triangular formation on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal vertex angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated profile; right lobe exhibits high-frequency jagged peaks (approx. 2-5 pixel amplitude) and several distinct notches; left lobe shows lower-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a primarily linear to slightly convex path, curving sharply upward at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast black circular spots (approx. 5-10 pixels diameter) on the right lobe; several raised white circular nodules (barnacles/scars) concentrated near the peduncle insertion point and right lobe edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct black linear markings (rake marks); one prominent long horizontal scratch on the lateral left lobe; multiple diagonal/curvilinear scratches on the central areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma present as irregular jagged nicks and a significant indentation on the right lobe trailing margin; extensive linear rake marks distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique triangular arrangement of three black punctate spots on the mid-right lobe; large horizontal linear disruption on the far left lobe.
